title: Scale Change catalog navigation
outcome: Blueprint users can find accumulated Changes by lifecycle status, capability, tag, text, and archive chronology without expanding every Change in the sidebar.
acceptanceCriteria: Each Change declares validated catalog metadata with hierarchical capability references and tags.
The Changes sidebar links directly to All, Discussing, In Progress, and Archive views.
Every Change page uses the built-in Fumadocs breadcrumb to navigate through lifecycle, Change, and page levels.
Nested historical folders without an explicit index resolve to a real descendant page so rendered breadcrumb items remain navigable.
Descendant resolution recognizes both child pages and Fumadocs folder.index pages.
Direct Change pages omitted by same-name artifact-directory collisions are restored from the canonical source page list.
Breadcrumb context preserves the canonical Change page order and does not duplicate a folder index as a child page.
Promoting a descendant page to a parent folder index does not leave a duplicate page-navigation entry or self-link.
Change cards show capability and tag badges.
Archive navigation uses an external timeline with month accordions.
verification: Verify sidebar filters, Change breadcrumbs, and archive accordions in the rendered Blueprint.
